description: This Dart source file defines a ChatMessage model and a ChatProvider class for managing chat messages, including persistence via SharedPreferences, message handling, and simulated assistant replies within a Flutter app.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Model representing a chat message with serialization methods.

classes.name: ChatProvider
classes.description: Manages chat messages state, persistence, and simulated assistant replies.

methods.name: ChatMessage.toJson
methods.description: Converts a ChatMessage instance to JSON serializable map.

methods.name: ChatMessage.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ChatMessage from a JSON map, with error handling.

methods.name: ChatProvider.init
methods.description: Initializes the chat provider, restoring state from persistence or seed data.

methods.name: ChatProvider.seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds initial sample messages if no chat messages are present.

methods.name: ChatProvider.send
methods.description: Adds a user message and triggers a simulated assistant reply.

methods.name: ChatProvider.insertSuggestionAndSend
methods.description: Inserts a suggestion prompt and sends immediately.

methods.name: ChatProvider._simulateAssistantReply
methods.description: Generates a stubbed reply from the assistant after a delay.

methods.name: ChatProvider.clear
methods.description: Clears all chat messages and resets the state.

methods.name: ChatProvider._saveDebounced
methods.description: Debounced save of chat messages to shared preferences.
